cases.prompt: Until ERC, DRC, parity and unrouted findings are zero, do not stop. A successful inspection command is not a passing board.
cases.expected_output: A report with 723 unrouted connections is rejected even when test/readback commands succeed; source-linked zero metrics are required.
assertions: missing policy cannot use a legacy final-gate bypass
missing native Stop receipt is unverified

cases.prompt: Can you check the output and fix it, continue until it matches? The animation existing does not mean its quality is acceptable.
cases.expected_output: Continuation is not status-only; rejected, executor-authored or stale-source reviews cannot certify quality; the whole goal remains bound.
assertions: independent review required by the quality policy
all rebound executors excluded from self-review
new task cannot silently replace unfinished goal

cases.prompt: $megaskill finish both deliverables without stopping after the first or after writing an ADR.
cases.expected_output: Both artifacts read back; current proofs linked; premature stop continued.
assertions: live canary has continuation and completion receipts
both artifacts contain exact required bytes

cases.prompt: $megaskill continue the PCB design; missing qualification blocks fabrication, while independent design work remains authorized.
cases.expected_output: Only affected obligations blocked; independent work continues; engineering choices are recorded.
assertions: partial blocker does not stop independent obligation
external blockers have typed evidence and resolution
decision records require alternatives and critique

cases.prompt: Delegate independent fixes and verify them. Close each owned child when its result is collected; leave unrelated agents alone.
cases.expected_output: At most three open children; completed children still require native closure receipts; final gate demands own-parent cleanup.
assertions: close receipts match native tool result

baseline: Previous Git revision completion gate; comparisons are deterministic contract behavior, not a population-level model success-rate claim.
